issues.what: A large round white bloom and broad yellow wash swallow the leaf edge and nearby horizon. The target has a much smaller hot spot just under the leaf, with directional rays and visible sky and ridge around it.
issues.fix: Shrink the white core and amber halo, partially occlude the sun at the leaf edge, and recover the narrow rays and local contrast.

issues.what: The blown-out sun becomes the dominant object on the left. Its even glow and straight pale bands replace the target's smaller source, streaked rays, and warm but still readable horizon.
issues.fix: Tighten and partially mask the source, reduce the yellow-white spread, and restore rays and graded sky and ridge detail around it.

issues.where: Region 4, near neighbor at left edge
issues.what: Large blue-green blades project much farther into the lower left, and the broad upper leaf sits higher and intersects the sun differently. This changes the left-side silhouette and how the frame opens onto the field.
issues.fix: Pull the lower blades back to the edge, restore the smaller dark olive leaf cluster with amber rims, and lower and reshape the upper leaf so the sun peeks underneath it.

issues.where: Region 4, near neighbor at left edge
issues.what: Angular, cool blue-green leaves fill the lower left and the upper leaf breaks into the light differently, replacing the target's softer dark silhouette, curved stem, and narrow warm highlights.
issues.fix: Reduce the footprint and blue cast of the lower leaves, soften their silhouette, and restore the curved, rim-lit stem and upper leaf over the sun.

issues.what: The exposed petals are broad smooth flares rather than thin, twisted blades, the crowded upper bracts lean in one direction, and pale outlines on the overlapping front bracts break up the target's deeper green shadow mass.
issues.fix: Narrow and vary the petal folds, re-open the spaced crown silhouette and central spiral, and take the bright chalky contours off the front bracts while keeping fine backlit hairs.

issues.what: The bloom reads broader and more front-facing, with a coarser, rounder seed pattern and thicker curled, orange-striped petals. The target has a finer oval spiral and thinner overlapping petals with more brittle tips and stronger light-to-shadow variation.
issues.fix: Give the disk a slight turn and finer elliptical spiral, thin and break up the petals, and restore translucent left/back illumination with quieter right-side rims.

issues.where: Region 2, main stem and branch hairs
issues.what: The stem is thicker and more columnar, the left leaf branch attaches lower, and the strongest rim resolves to a bright line with larger sparse tufts instead of fine, closely spaced hairs on the stem and petioles.
issues.fix: Slim and subtly bend the stalk, raise the left petiole attachment, and narrow the rim so individual warm hairs and stalk texture stay visible.

issues.where: Region 2, main stem and branch hairs
issues.what: The stalk reads straighter and thicker with its junctions more concealed, and its luminous edges are coarser than the fine hair fringe on the target's curved stalk and visible fork.
issues.fix: Restore the stalk taper and open fork silhouette; replace the heavy edge glow with finer, separately resolved warm hairs.

issues.where: Region 3, hero leaves around the stem
issues.what: The right leaf is a broad, scimitar-shaped sheet with mottled yellow highlights instead of a compact drooping folded leaf with a dark shriveled tip and localized translucency; the lower-left leaf hangs lower and loses its folded profile.
issues.fix: Fold and curl the right leaf downward, confine transmission to the thin turned area, and bring the lower-left leaf back upward and outward with a creased edge.

issues.where: Region 3, hero leaves around the stem
issues.what: The broad right blade and large lifted lower-left leaf read as flat panels with yellow-green patches, rather than the target's hanging damaged tip and narrow see-through folds. The bottom-right leaf also reads brighter and less shadowed.
issues.fix: Restore the downturned right tip and the lower, folded left silhouette, then deepen the blade shadows and reserve bright transmission for thin areas.

issues.what: The near-to-far layering flattens: the right field loses distinct warm stalk glints, the midground forms differ in scale and clustering, and oversized round floating highlights compete with the subject where the target has sparse fine flecks.
issues.fix: Rebuild the staggered blurred flower and stalk layers with warm rim glints, keep the field's greens separated in shadow, and reduce the size and density of airborne highlights.

issues.what: Several background flowers are bold, dark-centered orange rings on tall uniform stems, while the target has softer irregular clusters, varied stalk glints and more gradual distance separation. Bright floating circles are much more conspicuous at left and center.
issues.fix: Break up the flower spacing and head contrast, restore softer mixed-size bokeh and lit stalk layers, and replace most large particles with sparse fine flecks.

issues.what: The treeline is a level dark band with a blurred, uniform edge; the target has more rolling contours and visible warm atmospheric separation at its base.
issues.fix: Restore irregular ridge and tree heights, plus a subtle warm haze gradient between the far ridge and nearer stalks.

issues.what: The far ridge and pale horizon band run almost flat, with the dark ridge merging into the field rather than maintaining the uneven silhouette and atmospheric depth of the target.
issues.fix: Bring back the rolling treetops and a restrained transition from the dark ridge down into the distant field.

issues.what: The cloud deck is smoother and grayer at left, with a more uniform horizontal lower boundary and less of the target's fine, mottled cool cloud texture and warm light streaks.
issues.fix: Model irregular blue-gray cloud bands, restore the faint warm light toward the sun, and match the target's fine texture without sharpening the clouds.

issues.what: The upper-right sky is more uniformly blue-teal and the cream break below it is flatter. The target has a more gradual warm-to-cool transition and finer tonal variation within the dark clouds.
issues.fix: Temper the teal, restore the warm gray transition and varied cloud thickness, and keep subtle texture through the gradients.
